San Francisco, CA — April 16, 2026 — The artificial intelligence infrastructure sector is witnessing another meteoric rise as Upscale AI, a startup yet to launch a commercial product, engages in advanced talks to secure a funding round that would value the company at approximately $2 billion. Upscale AI is an AI infrastructure company reportedly focused on developing custom semiconductor chips (ASICs) and the full-stack software and networking systems required to make them work effectively at scale for artificial intelligence workloads. While companies like Nvidia and AMD provide general-purpose AI chips (GPUs), Upscale AI appears to be betting on custom, specialized chips paired with open-standards software. items.title: Anthropic turns away record VC offers amid AI valuation boom
items.snippet: Anthropic is reportedly declining venture capital funding offers that would valu...
items.raw_snippet: Anthropic is reportedly declining venture capital funding offers that would value the company at up to $800 billion, according to TechCrunch, highlighting the rapid escalation in AI startup valuations across late-stage private markets. Reported Anthropic AI valuation discussions place the company among the most highly valued private technology firms in history, reflecting a broader surge in artificial intelligence capital markets. This shift has blurred the line between venture capital and public market investing, effectively turning private AI companies into quasi-public assets in terms of capital scale and investor composition. The reported valuation dynamics surrounding Anthropic highlight a new stage in the global AI investment cycle, where AI startup valuation is driven by institutional competition, crossover capital, and strategic funding scarcity rather than traditional venture capital constraints. As VC funding offers escalate and companies become more selective, the artificial intelligence sector is evolving into a hybrid capital market — blending characteristics of private venture investing with public-market scale valuation behavior.

items.raw_snippet: LONDON, April 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Diginex Limited (“Diginex” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: DGNX), a leading provider of Sustainability RegTech solutions, today announced that it has signed a definitive Share Purchase Agreement (“SPA”) to acquire Resulticks Global Companies Pte Limited (“Resulticks”), a globally recognized leader in real‑time, AI‑driven customer intelligence solutions, in an all‑share transaction valued at US$1.5 billion, paid in full with Diginex shares at $1.32 per share. As data and artificial intelligence emerge as the primary drivers of enterprise differentiation, the synergies created by the merging of the businesses aims to create the world’s first trust led growth platform where Resulticks’ leading customer intelligence platform embeds sustainability journeys directly into customer engagement. **“This transaction transforms the group’s financials and significantly deepens our expertise in AI and data management.** By combining Resulticks’ real-time data capabilities with our sustainability platforms, we are poised to redefine how organizations navigate sustainability and compliance challenges.”.

items.raw_snippet: # Wealth.com Secures $65M to Expand AI Estate Platform. [Davis Janowski,](/author/davis-janowski)Senior Technology Editor, Wealth Management. The estate planning platform Wealth.com has raised $65 million in a Series B funding round intended to accelerate further development of its AI-driven estate and tax planning platform. Proceeds from the Series B will be used to enhance AI and product development, support strategic acquisitions, expand enterprise distribution and open a New York City office in May. Wealth.com’s proprietary AI engine, Ester Intelligence, processed over 100,000 estate documents in 2025, delivering deterministic calculations for estate distributions, according to the company. The company [expanded its platform earlier this year to include tax planning](/financial-technology/wealth-com-announces-the-launch-of-proprietary-tax-planning-platform), creating what it intends to be a comprehensive solution for advisors and clients. items.raw_snippet: # Sam Altman on AI's Future and Open Source. Sam Altman discusses AI safety, open-source models, and the future economic impact of AI. OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, a pivotal figure shaping the trajectory of artificial intelligence, recently shared his candid thoughts on the future of AI, its inherent risks, and the delicate balance of development in a conversation on the Lex Fridman Podcast. Sam Altman on AI's Future and Open Source - AI Engineer. Sam Altman on AI's Future and Open Source — from AI Engineer. The discussion, hosted by AI researcher Lex Fridman, offered a rare glimpse into Altman’s vision for AI’s societal impact, touching upon everything from existential risks to the economic implications of advanced artificial intelligence. The implication for the startup world is clear: while open-source tools can accelerate innovation, companies developing frontier AI models will face pressure to demonstrate robust safety measures. #Sam Altman#OpenAI#Lex Fridman#Artificial Intelligence#AI Safety.
